entries.title: Psalms 108:1
segments: ¶<<A Song, a Psalm of David.>> My heart is fixed, O God: I will sing, yea, I will sing psalms, even [with] my glory.

entries.title: Psalms 108:2
segments: Awake, lute and harp: I will wake the dawn.

entries.title: Psalms 108:3
segments: I will give thee thanks among the peoples, O Jehovah; of thee will I sing psalms among the nations:

entries.title: Psalms 108:4
segments: For thy loving-kindness is great above the heavens, and thy truth is unto the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 108:5
segments: Be thou exalted above the heavens, O God, and thy glory above all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 108:6
segments: ¶That thy beloved ones may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

entries.title: Psalms 108:7
segments: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

entries.title: Psalms 108:8
segments: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine, and Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my law-giver;

entries.title: Psalms 108:9
segments: Moab is my wash-pot; upon Edom will I cast my sandal; over Philistia will I shout aloud.

entries.title: Psalms 108:10
segments: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me unto Edom?

entries.title: Psalms 108:11
segments: [Wilt] not [thou], O God, who didst cast us off? and didst not go forth, O God, with our armies?

entries.title: Psalms 108:12
segments: Give us help from trouble; for vain is man's deliverance.

entries.title: Psalms 108:13
segments: Through God we shall do valiantly; and he it is that will tread down our adversaries.
